findings.statement: The trained lower computational stack is independently reproduced statewise on all 4,486,550 reachable states across the three hard carriers, including ROLE_CAPPAR_ZOE and OOO ranks 75/294/16.

The strongest pooled two-row contradiction is created by erasing frontier-vs-positive-depth information. Depth parity remains insufficient; zero-versus-positive depth is sufficient in the frozen SIGNED_PARITY grid.

The geometry-blind pooled-functional requirement is a stronger research objective than EW-RS059 requires. Geometry-tagged local structure already removes the pooled conflict, so failure of a geometry-blind quotient is not failure of a geometry-parameterized closed decoder.

The apparent owner1 privilege in RS094 is representation-relative under fixed owner labels: the exact sufficient link transports to owner0 under a complete owner relabeling. It is not yet a mover/opponent law.

A promising interpretation of the surviving obstruction is an independence defect: geometry determines which normalized local objects are genuinely independent, and frontier/support attachment is one demonstrated component of that defect.

Full OOO remains provisional as a general late interaction law. Fresh phase-1 revalidation was non-discriminating on 3x7-k4 and resource-censored on 7x3-k4; no fresh non-affine qualification has yet been obtained.
